title: Bump opum-lore federated pin to v0.9.3
description: lore-cli's LCLI-469 handshake (2-part: tag cut, then npm publish confirmation), independently re-resolved rather than trusted from the relay.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tag chain independently re-resolved via the GitHub API (v0.9.3 -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree), cross-checked via git ls-remote --tags as a second source
skills subtree SHA confirmed byte-identical to the v0.9.2 baseline via direct tree resolution
plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.9.3; npm dist-tags.latest confirmed 0.9.3 on the main package and all 6 platform packages
lore check and lore agents --check both pass locally under lore@0.9.3 installed fresh
PR opened, required checks green, task closed inside that same PR before merge, promoted to main

finalSummary: lore-cli's LCLI-469 tag-cut and publish handshake, sent as two separate messages this time (tag cut, then npm publish confirmation), independently re-verified rather than trusted: tag chain (ref v0.9.3 -> tag object c07b0ea48a1fd236b436293b20ac34a767c8a8e8 -> commit 819a682c6050dc780ec8919910d4aa5c235a2878 -> root tree e687e7d2d7e27679cf0e5b6f3b3297126cc92f84 -> skills subtree ce580cd17d1da6a61ddb53f649398719b9262f96) matches lore-cli's claimed SHAs exactly, cross-checked via both the GitHub API and git ls-remote --tags. skills/ subtree is byte-identical to the v0.9.2 baseline, confirmed by direct tree resolution rather than the compare API's absent-diff heuristic alone. v0.9.3 is a patch spanning 9 commits / 47 files, none under skills/. plugin.json self-declares 0.9.3, confirmed by direct GitHub API read; npm dist-tags.latest confirmed independently as 0.9.3 on the main package and all 6 platform packages. lore check (2 files, 0 errors) and lore agents --check (both bridge files up-to-date, no regeneration needed) verified locally under 0.9.3 via npx, not the older global install. Both scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and scripts/check-federated-content.mjs pass clean locally against the bumped pin and baseline. All three required checks green on PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#154's head SHA b5a5cc6a.
